cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before we discuss me moving out, can you check my train time again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six twelve. I've checked five times, and your ticket's in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Good. Does this ticket work at the barrier, or do I need the booking email?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll walk you through the barrier. Are you scared of leaving me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you're coming onto the platform, we need to check whether you need a ticket too.

mechanism: A authorizes travel steps only after another check, turning B offered escort into a new ticket prerequisite that avoids naming fear of leaving.
confusable: D98 uses support to become ready to act alone; D110 keeps finding logistical topics so the fear is not reached.
comparison: Train barrier details differ from a scholarship letter delayed by tea labeling.
seedUse: Use D110-b five repeated time checks, real ticket and B escort solution as causes of successive practical redirection.
